tasks.CalculateAnnualProductionCost: Calculate the total annual production cost by multiplying the monthly production cost by 12 months.
tasks.CalculateMonthlyProductionCost: Calculate the monthly production cost for the company based on the number of units produced per month and the cost per component.
tasks.DetermineRequiredRevenue: Determine the required revenue to meet the yearly profit goal after accounting for the annual production costs.
tasks.SetSellingPrice: Set the minimum selling price per component based on the required revenue and the number of components sold annually.
